GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly, given a squeeze & Went Forward to 2 Lengths Lead on fence, extended lead out in front & led 3.5 Lengths turning, ran out of puff in straight, Headed 75m out and Lost Ground to the line. [Stewards: Raced keenly in the lead. Rider reported after beginning fairly he gave it a squeeze and, when it responded, allowed him to lead as anticipated. He added that, having gained the lead, he was unable to get it to relax and went at a faster tempo than he would have liked resulting in it weakening over the concluding stages.] # went hard in front
Jumped okay, ridden positively & Went Forward to 1 length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led same turning, kept going in Straight and Headed 30m or So from post # led/battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out over the concluding stages under pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down 2nd Outside 1 Lengths faced breeze Good Pace on, Soon After 3 Wide kept on tough to 200m Couldn'T Go On - forgive, # had no favours
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped. Raced wide throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 3 Wide 3rd 1 Lengths had no favours Held Together Out On A Limb to Straightening Up 2nd x 300m, kept on tough to 200m Couldn'T Go On - # 3 wide, gave all

Jumped Ok Ridden Along Went Forward Settled Down 1/2 Lengths Clear allowed to dictate terms race run to suit to Straightening Up , led 2 Lengths x 300m Kept Finding (b/off xovnboff t/t/1st w/1st) # dictated, gave all
Jumped Fair sat back 8-9l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and bumped. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 5l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, battled on one pace # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. After being crossed passing the 1200m, raced keenly for a short distance thereafter.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well pressed on to lead 1-2l clear, held together turn, joined Straightening Up , drew half clear 200m, headed passing 100m, kept on ok just no match late # led/headed 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat box seat 3-4l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off all clear, joined in approaching 200m, soon headed, battled on strong to the line just no match once headed by winner # had run/good
Jumped Ok sat 3l off but 3 Wide No Cover , gave ground turn, Straightened Up well off, plodded home # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event. Near the 600m shifted in and bumped. Shortly after passing the 400m was briefly unable to be fully tested when in restricted room between runners. A post-race veterinary examination of the filly did not reveal any abnormalities.
